profile.name: Mira Qon Corp
profile.category: Non-accelerated filer · Smaller reporting company · Emerging growth company

intro.text: Mira Qon Corporation (the “Company” or “Mira Qon”) is an early-stage technology company incorporated in Wyoming on June 16, 2025 . The Company develops and operates an online service providing real-time pricing information for construction materials across the United States. Mira Qon is designed to serve contractors, developers, architects, procurement teams, and software developers by delivering accurate, up-to-date material cost data by state and ZIP code. The Company’s website is operational as an informational resource (accessible at https://miraqon.com). The Mira Qon core application programming interface (“API”), which provides real-time pricing data, was completed on February 3, 2026, and has since been deployed on the Company’s website, where it is currently commercially available to users (accessible at https://miraqon.com/#pricing).

s.t: These enhancements are planned; there is no assurance they will be completed, and they depend on additional funding

The Company has a short operating history, has generated limited revenue, and depends on advances from its director and additional financing to fund operations; however, the Company’s cash position may not be sufficient to support the Company’s daily operations.
